description: When a schema enum is supplied through a YAML alias, the parser exposes the resolved enum values in their original order.

input.yaml:
openapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: Test
  version: "1.0"
paths: {}
components:
  schemas:
    AnchorOwner:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: &status_values
            - Active
            - Inactive
            - Pending
    AliasConsumer:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum: *status_values
